verdict.rationale: Firecrawl documents outbound HTTPS webhooks. Crawl, batch scrape, extract, agent job and monitor events are delivered to a user-provided endpoint, so you don't have to poll. The docs also cover HMAC-SHA256 signature verification and local testing. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of webhook delivery, and documented event-type/payload detail beyond the overview.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: Get notified the moment a crawl, batch scrape, extract, agent job, or monitor check starts, progresses, or finishes. Instead of polling for status, you provide an HTTPS endpoint
Verify that every webhook request actually came from Firecrawl by checking its HMAC-SHA256 signature.
